Strength • Design • Quality • Travel • Geometry• Build Kits • Technical Specs

The Tetra Tandem finds its roots in the first carbon bicycle to ever roll out of Craig Calfee’s garage. Tetra’s carbon tubing is unmatched in terms of durability and strength, favoring a lower modulus carbon to achieve a robustness suited for traveling, bike-packing, or whatever you have to throw at it.

The Tetra Adventure tandem can utilize molded chainstays and seatstays to offer a more comfortable and controlled feel over harsher terrain. The layout is designed to be vertically complaint, yet torsionally stiff, offering a supple rear end feel that doesn’t compromise pedaling performance.

Our wrapped lug design provides a level of comfort and compliance that procures an astounding ride quality that few other bikes can deliver. Through more than 30 years of research, development, and advancements in the carbon bicycle industry, we’ve perfected our unique manufacturing process to develop the perfect tailored ride for every tandem team.

Our expert-selected build kits utilize your favorite components from the likes of SRAM, Shimano, Campagnolo, and more to deliver a well rounded package while eliminating the guess work related to tandem construction and specifications. Each unique build kit is thoroughly tested to ensure maximum reliability and performance. See available build kits for this model.

Custom engineered hard-shell traveling cases to protect and pack your tandem. Travel case come fitted with tube protective wrapping to fit your specific tandem, custom fork mount, wheel bag, frame mounting points.

Compact case and Wheelcase option: Bike fits in one compact case and wheels go in separate wheel case. This is the current most popular option as it’s easier to manage two lighter pieces of luggage than one big one. You can also carry more stuff, like helmets, water bottles, shoes, etc. without going overweight. Most airlines will still charge for one bike fee even though it’s packed in two cases.
